title: Owens' 168 demonstrations over 20 years

tellings.quote: 168 different demonstrations he performed over a period of 20 years. Roughly twothirds of them worked out the way he said they would.

plain: A man named Ted Owens is said to have carried out 168 demonstrations of powers he claimed to have, over about 20 years from around 1960, and about two thirds of them "worked out the way he said they would." The parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove, who keeps his own files on Owens, gives these figures. If they hold, Owens could make things happen by predicting or calling for them.
